test_title: PYST 4 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A can do a work in 15 days, B in 30 days. They start together but A leaves after 5 days. In how many more days will B complete the remaining work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = **LCM(15, 30) = 30 units**.

Efficiency of **A = 2** and **B = 1** (Combined = 3 units/day).

Work done by **(A+B)** in **5 days** = 3 × 5 = **15 units**.

Remaining work = 30 − 15 = **15 units**.

Time for B to finish remaining work = 15 ÷ 1 = **15 days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **A = 15 days** and **B = 30 days**. They work together for **5 days**.

**Formula:** Total Work = LCM of individual time; Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time taken.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **A**
 15
 30 (LCM)
 30 ÷ 15 = 2
 
 

 **B**
 30
 30 ÷ 30 = 1
 
 

⇒ Combined efficiency of **A + B = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day**.

⇒ Work done by **A and B** together in **5 days** = 5 × 3 = **15 units**.

⇒ Remaining work = Total Work − Completed Work = 30 − 15 = **15 units**.

⇒ Time taken by **B** to complete the **remaining work** = 15 ÷ 1 = **15 days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between Time and Efficiency

Time and efficiency are inversely proportional to each other. If the ratio of time taken is x:y, then the ratio of efficiency is y:x.

Pipes and Cisterns

The same LCM method applies to pipes, where filling pipes have positive efficiency and outlet/leakage pipes have negative efficiency.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed among workers based on the ratio of the actual work done by each person.</p
